verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents importers/exporters (glTF, OBJ, STL, DCC plugins) but there is no evidence of automatable batch-import hooks, presets, or pipeline scripting for headless/CLI asset processing without manual UI interaction — the evidence only covers runtime scene loading and manual sandbox/playground tools. missing for 10: CLI/batch import automation, pipeline hook/preset system, evidence of unattended asset ingestion scripts.
